claim: GET /metrics serves a REAL aggregate of a REAL, recorded ledger — never a constant. Vera's operator dashboard (#dashknob -> openDash() -> fetch('/metrics')) renders three identity-health gauges (contamination / coherence / growth) plus the pre-registered DECISION-RULE verdict. The live turn FEEDS that ledger: every model reply is scored for break-character and appended (mouth.py: metrics.note_reply(heart.name, raw_text)), narrative-gate decisions feed coherence (narrative.py: metrics.note_narrative), sleep-cycle consolidations feed growth (live.py: metrics.note_growth) — each one an append-only jsonl line on .anima/{name}.metrics.jsonl. GET /metrics then serves {**metrics.summary(name), "verdict": metrics.verdict(name)}, opt-in behind ANIMA_METRICS=1 (OFF -> 404). summary() is computed FROM the recorded events (organic_break_rate == broken/n), so adding an event MOVES the number and a creature with no events reads None — the endpoint mirrors the ledger, it cannot synthesise. The sibling flight-recorder ledger anima/telemetry.py round-trips its own append-only traces (begin -> observations -> decision -> commit -> replay off .anima/{name}.telemetry.jsonl, plus a full-schema MRI trace).
owner: anima/metrics.py (note_reply/note_narrative/note_growth append events to .anima/{name}.metrics.jsonl via _append; scan_breaks = the deterministic class-based break-character detector; summary(name) aggregates the three gauges; verdict(name) = the pre-registered DECISION RULE), anima/server.py (GET /metrics -> gated `os.environ.get('ANIMA_METRICS') != '1'` -> 404 else 200 {**metrics.summary(name), 'verdict': metrics.verdict(name)}), anima/mouth.py (metrics.note_reply on the live reply — the recording seam), anima/narrative.py + anima/live.py (the coherence + growth recording seams), anima/telemetry.py (the sibling bus + MRI flight-recorder ledger; --selftest), anima/web/index.html (#dashknob -> openDash() fetches /metrics and renders the gauges + verdict, with an honest 'start the server with ANIMA_METRICS=1' fallback)

killer_test.name: an_event_is_recorded_and_metrics_serves_a_real_aggregate_of_it
killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store (metrics.STORE + telemetry.STORE redirected via gate0_prime_experience._temp_store). (A) metrics.note_reply (the EXACT call the live mouth makes) appends a real jsonl line to .anima/{name}.metrics.jsonl: a grounded-warmth reply records ZERO breaks, a substrate-disclosure reply records >=1; the ledger is append-only (one line per reply) and reads back as structured reply events. (B) metrics.summary(name).contamination reflects the recorded events (organic_n counts replies, organic_broken counts broken, organic_break_rate == round(broken/n,3)); recording another break MOVES the rate; a fresh creature with no events reads None; note_narrative moves coherence and note_growth moves growth. (C) reproduce EXACTLY what GET /metrics serves -- {**metrics.summary(name), 'verdict': metrics.verdict(name)} -- and assert it is byte-equal to summary()+verdict computed directly off the ledger, carries the real DECISION-RULE verdict, is JSON-serialisable, and the ANIMA_METRICS gate is enforced (unset/!=1 -> 404; =1 -> 200 payload). (D) serving /metrics writes nothing (ledger byte-unchanged). (E) anima/telemetry.py --selftest passes as a subprocess. Real .anima byte-identical before/after. scripts/certify_metrics_telemetry.py is the executable form.

known_gaps: The recording seam is exercised through the SAME function the live mouth calls (metrics.note_reply with a real reply string scored by the production scan_breaks), and the served payload is reproduced byte-for-byte from the server.do_GET expression {**metrics.summary(name), 'verdict': metrics.verdict(name)} including the literal ANIMA_METRICS gate -- but the cert does NOT spawn the running HTTP server or generate a reply from a live model (no Ollama). The full mouth.note_reply call site fires only on a live model turn; here the event is recorded via that exact ledger API rather than by driving a model. This is the deterministic, offline floor of the contract; the model/network/HTTP-socket leg is the stated gap.

The eval-side gauges (adversarial eval_break_rate, the verdict's rate) read .anima/persona_probe.json, produced by scripts/persona_probe.py against the active local model; with no probe file the verdict honestly reports 'no adversarial data yet' rather than fabricating a number. The cert certifies the ORGANIC (live-reply) recording path + aggregation + endpoint determinism, not the separately-produced adversarial battery.
